values.value: about one-third of maximum rear travel

values.joint: Suspension / Shock / Race sag less (95 mm example)
values.value: less sag (e.g. 95 mm / 3.7 in) improves turning in tight terrain, slightly less straight-line stability

values.joint: Suspension / Shock / Race sag more (115 mm example)
values.value: more sag (e.g. 115 mm / 4.5 in) may improve stability on fast terrain but slows turning

Suspension / Shock / Rear traction tip
values.value: for more rear traction raise rear by running about 90 mm sag instead of 100 mm

values.joint: Suspension guideline / Track / Soft surface
values.value: sand and mud: more compression damping front and rear; sand: a bit more rebound; mud: consider stiffer optional springs

values.joint: Suspension guideline / Track / Hard surface
values.value: fast hard track without big jumps: standard springs, softer compression and rebound damping

values.joint: Suspension guideline / Shock / Sand track
values.value: increase race sag +5 to 10 mm (+0.2 to 0.4 in); stiffer compression and especially rebound

values.joint: Suspension guideline / Shock / Mud track
values.value: stiffer damping, optional stiff spring, reduce race sag -5 to -10 mm (-0.2 to -0.4 in)

values.joint: Suspension guideline / Fork / Oil volume step
values.value: raise or lower fork oil in 5 cm3 (0.2 US oz) steps

values.joint: Suspension guideline / General / Adjustment step
values.value: one click or 1/12 turn at a time, test ride after each change

values.joint: Suspension guideline / Shock / Stiff on small bumps
values.value: softer low speed compression first, then low and high speed together

values.joint: Suspension guideline / Shock / Bottoms on jump landings
values.value: stiffer high speed compression; then both compression and stiff spring if needed

values.joint: Suspension guideline / Shock / Bottoms after continuous bumps
values.value: softer rebound; then stiffer compression with softer rebound and stiff spring if needed

values.joint: Controls / Levers / Mounting
